input: What is the refund rate for products in the Electronics category?

expected_result.derivation: psql, independent of the app: approved refunded Electronics units (10) divided by total Electronics units sold (23) = 0.4348. Checked by hand against the 20 raw order_item rows - no order_item has more than one refund, and none are denied or pending.
expected_result.review_note: Generated SQL counts order_item rows instead of unit quantity as the denominator (COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) instead of SUM(oi.quantity)), confirmed by reading the generated SQL directly.

generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_refunds, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS total_order_items, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS refund_rate_pct FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN refunds AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' LIMIT 500
failed_checks: Generated SQL counts order_item rows instead of unit quantity as the denominator (COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) instead of SUM(oi.quantity)), confirmed by reading the generated SQL directly.
